skill.name: fal-image-edit
skill.description: Guidance for AI image editing tasks, including style transfer and object removal.
skill.summary: Plan clear AI image edits for style transfer, object removal, and related transformations.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The static network findings are repository links in SKILL.md metadata and prose. The skill is prompt-only, contains no executable code, and I found no prompt injection or data-exfiltration intent.

finding_verdicts.reason: The URL is source metadata pointing to an upstream repository, not executable network behavior. The skill contains no code that sends data to this URL.
The URL is a documentation link for more information. It is not an instruction to transmit data or call an external service.

content.value_statement: Image edit requests can be vague and hard to translate into model instructions. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code shape clear guidance for style transfer, object removal, and image edits.
actual_capabilities: Provides written guidance for AI-powered image editing tasks.
Explains when to use the skill for image editing work.
Links to the upstream source repository for reference.
limitations: It is prompt-only and does not include an image editor or API client.
It does not define model parameters, file formats, or quality settings.
It cannot verify final image quality without user-provided results.
It does not include automation for uploading images or saving outputs.

use_cases.title: Prepare Style Transfer Prompts
use_cases.description: Create concise edit directions before applying a visual style to an image.

use_cases.title: Plan Product Image Cleanup
use_cases.description: Define which objects should be removed and what should stay unchanged.

use_cases.title: Add Image Edit Guidance
use_cases.description: Use lightweight instructions when adding image edit prompts to an assistant workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Object Removal
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single cleanup edit.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me write an AI image edit request to remove [object] from [image description] while preserving [background details].

prompt_templates.title: Style Transfer Request
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for applying a defined visual style.
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn my goal into a clear image edit prompt: apply [style] to [subject] while keeping [required details] recognizable.

prompt_templates.title: Focused Revision Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request after reviewing an edited image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this image edit result: [describe result]. Suggest a follow-up request that fixes [issue] without changing [protected elements].

prompt_templates.title: Multi-Step Edit Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a complete editing workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a staged image editing brief for [image]. Include object removal, style transfer, quality checks, and final acceptance criteria.

output_examples.input: Remove a coffee cup from a desk photo while keeping shadows natural.
output_examples.output: Remove the coffee cup from the desk. Reconstruct the desktop texture and natural shadows. Keep the notebook, keyboard, and lighting unchanged.

output_examples.input: Apply a watercolor style to a portrait without changing the face.
output_examples.output: Apply a soft watercolor style to the portrait. Preserve facial structure, expression, skin tone, and eye detail. Use light paper texture.

output_examples.input: Create a revision request for an object removal result with blurry edges.
output_examples.output: Refine the removed area edges and match the surrounding texture. Keep the subject position, lighting, and background composition unchanged.

best_practices: Describe the image, target edit, and protected elements in one request.
Name the style with visual details such as lighting, color, texture, and era.
Review edited results and ask for one focused revision at a time.
anti_patterns: Requesting broad changes without saying what should remain unchanged.
Combining object removal, style transfer, and retouching without priorities.
Using copyrighted character or brand styles when you need original commercial artwork.

faq.question: Does this skill edit images directly?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance for writing AI image editing requests.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It is listed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it help remove objects?
faq.answer: Yes. It helps write object removal requests with preservation details.

faq.question: Can it help with style transfer?
faq.answer: Yes. It helps describe the target style and protected image details.

faq.question: Does it call fal.ai or another service?
faq.answer: The reviewed skill does not include code that calls an external service.

faq.question: What should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the image description, desired edit, protected areas, and output goals.
